tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and screen background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: the spellbook page, hero cards, the encounter briefing.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells set into a panel: the code editor, the replay log, meter tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel borders, dividers between rules. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls a player clicks or drags (buttons, sigils, inputs): at least 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and code, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, line numbers, moment numbers and code keywords, on ground, surface, surface-sunk and gilt-soft.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: The one accent, and it always means "now": the Run button, the gilt tab on the rule that fired and on the current replay moment, the selected hero, the focus ring. As text, on ground, surface and gilt-soft.

tokens.name: gilt-soft
tokens.usage: Row background behind the rule that fired and the current replay moment.

tokens.name: on-gilt
tokens.usage: Text on a gilt fill: the Run button label and the number inside a gilt tab.

tokens.name: harm
tokens.usage: Outcome colour for harm: damage numbers, burning, HP below 30%, and errors in a spellbook. Combat data and errors only, never chrome. As text, on ground, surface and surface-sunk; always with a number or a word.

tokens.name: mend
tokens.usage: Outcome colour for healing: healing numbers and the HP meter fill. Combat data only. As text, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: guard
tokens.usage: Outcome colour for protection and resources: shields, taunts, the focus meter fill. Combat data only. As text, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: fizzle
tokens.usage: A spell cast without its conditions met. Always with the word "fizzled" and a strikethrough; never colour alone. As text, on ground, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: keyword
tokens.usage: Spellbook keywords (if, and, not, when, cast, on): an alias of ink-muted, so logic words sit back and spells and targets stand forward.

families.code: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Grenze: Roman letters on blackletter bones, so it reads as a grimoire without the costume-shop look of uncial fantasy faces. Titles, names and impact numbers only; never paragraphs.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the encounter or screen name.

styles.name: impact
styles.usage: Damage and healing numbers floating over the battlefield, coloured by outcome.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible: drawn so similar letters (l, 1, I; 0, O) never blur together, which serves the pillar that every failure must be readable.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mend restores every ally, but only fires when two or more are hurt.
styles.usage: Spell descriptions, tutorials, dialogue, everything prose.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under names, tooltips, helper text, rule state words.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat names beside meters (HP, Focus) only. Uppercase with text-transform; one or two words at most.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono: the same letterforms as the text face, so sigils, code and prose read as one language. Mono only ever sets real spellbook code, never headings.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Spellbook lines in the editor and in enemy spellbooks.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Replay log entries, moment numbers, inline sigils in prose.

spacing.note: 4px base. Code rows are 24px tall, so vertical rhythm in the editor runs on space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a sigil's keyword and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between a meter and its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, gutter of the code editor.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between hero cards, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: One code row; between groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels and screen regions.

radius.note: Nearly square, like cut tablets and printed pages. Only meters are round, because a fill reads as liquid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Sigils, badges, gilt tabs, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Meter tracks and fills only.

shadow.note: Panels sit on the ground with a border, not a shadow. Shadows mark the only things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus, and a sigil while it is being dragged.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-colour gap, then 2px of solid gilt. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.
